## Reproduction rules (fails)

- **`ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` clause 6** (stale-spec): ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed clause 6 pins the old revocation text; since #23367 a revoked stdio key raises the API_KEY_REVOKED envelope
  - repro: 1) As the member, POST /api/v1/keys (Origin header on os start) → osk_ key K, id I. 2) From examples/app-showcase: OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true OS_MCP_STDIO_API_KEY=K objectstack start -p P -d file:DB, stdin/stdout piped; initialize; tools/call query_records {objectName: showcase_invoice} → 3 rows. 3) As admin, PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/I {"revoked":true} → 200. 4) tools/call query_records again. Expected (item): error "MCP stdio identity is no longer valid (key revoked or expired)". Actual: isError true, {"error":{"code":"API_KEY_REVOKED","message":"This API key (osk_…) was revoked, and a revoked key never works again. Create a new key …"}}. No data served — the fail-closed behavior holds, only the pinned text moved.
  - mechanism: packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts resolvePrincipal (~688-699): comment "[#23367] A key its own lifecycle refuses raises its branded 403 envelope out of this call"; the old "no longer valid" Error now fires only when resolution returns null without a branded refusal
